tools.name: search_currencies
tools.description: Find coins and tokens by symbol, name or network and get their currency ids. Each id is one coin on one network: usdttrc20 is USDT on TRON, usdterc20 is USDT on Ethereum. Use the ids in get_quote and create_swap.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Estimate how much the user receives for sending an amount, with the minimum and maximum for the pair. Network fees are already taken out of estimatedAmount. The rate floats, so the result is an estimate, not a promise. Show any warnings to the user.

tools.name: create_swap
tools.description: Create a swap order and get a one-time deposit address. Nothing moves until the user sends the deposit from their own wallet. tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.description: Current status of a swap by its id. Statuses: new, waiting (no deposit seen yet), confirming, exchanging, sending, finished, failed, refunded, verifying (paused for a check), expired.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_swap" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
